alt: 孩子透過萬花筒觀看，大人輕轉前端，周圍的小景顯示相同彩色碎片不斷組合出各種不同的放射圖案。
scene_prompt: Modern science museum, a child looks through a simple unbranded kaleidoscope held correctly in both hands. Around the child, five soft-edged circular close-up thought bubbles clearly linked to the same kaleidoscope show five DIFFERENT intricate radial patterns made from the SAME tiny colored glass triangles and circles, rotated and recombined in endlessly varied arrangements. Adult companion gently twists the front rotating ring while child watches with wonder. Physical kaleidoscope one long tube, eye to eyepiece, front ring gripped lightly. Patterns are optical diagrams in inset bubbles, not solid objects floating in room. Strong focus on abundant changing configurations, not merely many different items. Pencil-watercolor-colored pencil ivory paper, 3:2 landscape, no readable text brands letters numerals logos or watermarks.
